assumptions: CLI route `--metric dssim` -> native CPU umbrella (metrics/mod.rs:2547-2553) -> cpu_dispatch.rs:1450-1469: dssim.create_image_rgb(RGB<u8>) for both images then dssim.compare(&ref, dist). Pinned sibling dssim @ eec33f55 (~/tmp/iqa-cx-lead/snap/work/dssim, dssim-core).

Dssim::new() defaults: scale_weights = DEFAULT_WEIGHTS (5 scales, dssim.rs:85,156) and save_maps_scales = 0 -> SsimMap structs are dropped in compare_inner; the map fold still runs, but no map storage cost beyond the transient ImgVec.

Scale pyramid: make_scales_recursive (dssim.rs:219-275) calls to_lab on the CURRENT RGBLU image at every scale and recursively downsamples the RGBLU image (image.rs:204-228) with 2x2 Average4 box (average4 impls image.rs:129-153). Recursion stops when width<8 or height<8; tally assumes all S=5 levels exist (min(W,H) >= 256). Dims use floor(W/2) per level.

Preprocess per channel per scale (dssim.rs:118-140): chroma channels (a,b) get blur_in_place first; then EVERY channel gets blur() -> mu and blur_mul(img,img) -> img_sq_blur. Blur is a fused H5+V5 double-3-tap equivalent 5-tap separable pass (blur.rs:7-9,40,110,288); each pass materializes a full tmp/dst plane.

blur_mul (blur.rs:202,344) fuses the elementwise product INTO the 5-tap gather: per tap it loads a[i] and b[i] and multiplies -> 10 loads + 5 mul + 4 fma + 1 store per element per 1-D pass (no product plane is materialized).

Compare (compare_inner dssim.rs:268-335): per scale, 3 fused blur_mul cross-blurs (img1*img2 per channel, 3 parallel H5V5) then compare_scale_3ch (dssim.rs:335-395) computes the 3-channel-combined SSIM map pointwise, then two scalar folds (mean, mean |dev|) + powf reweight per scale. Scales run under par_bridge -> per-scale work is parallel; barrier per scale only for the scalar fold.
to_lab per px (tolab.rs:29-47): 3x fma_matrix (r,g,b -> X,Y,Z), 3x cbrt_poly (tolab.rs:66-81: ~4 int bit ops + 2 Halley steps of ~2 mul + 2 fma + 1 div each) + piecewise cmp + Lab assembly muls/fmas.
to_rgblu (linear.rs:194-197): per-pixel u8 -> linear f32 via gamma LUT (P::make_lut + px.to_linear) - 3 LUT loads + 3 stores, no arithmetic.
Edge handling: blur_h5/v5 use clamped replicated taps at edges with identical op counts to interior (blur.rs:36-40). No padding copies.
bytes_read/written are unique-footprint bytes per element (input planes touched once in cache), not per-tap traffic.

stages.name: RGB8 -> RGBLU via gamma LUT
stages.notes: Vec<RGBLU> collected at full res; LUT gather, no arithmetic (linear.rs:190-197).

stages.name: RGBLU 2x2 box downsample (average4)
stages.notes: Average4 over RGBLU = 4px x 3ch loads, (a+b+c+d)*0.25 per ch. Produces level l+1 RGB image consumed by to_lab and the next downsample (dssim.rs:219-260).

stages.name: RGBLU -> L*a*b* planes (per scale)
stages.notes: to_lab returns Vec<GBitmap> of 3 full planes per scale. Level 0 reads the to_rgblu image directly (dep conservatively charges downsample halo at l>=1).

stages.name: chroma in-place blur, horizontal 5-tap (a,b)
stages.notes: blur_in_place on a and b only (is_chroma, dssim.rs:132-134); fused H5V5 double-3-tap kernel, full tmp scratch between passes.

stages.name: mu blur, horizontal 5-tap (L,a,b)
stages.notes: blur() -> mu Vec (full plane). Chroma channels read the in-place-blurred a,b (chain r2+r2); L reads the unblurred plane.

stages.name: img_sq blur_mul(img,img), horizontal fused 5-tap
stages.notes: Fused multiply inside the tap loop (blur.rs:198-200): no product plane materialized; a==b so unique read footprint is one plane.

stages.name: img1*img2 cross blur_mul, horizontal (3ch, once per pair)
stages.notes: img1_img2_blur per channel (dssim.rs:144-151 -> blur_mul(src,modified)); reads both images' post-in-place-blur planes. Runs once per image pair, not per image.

stages.name: 3-channel combined SSIM map pointwise
stages.notes: compare_scale_3ch: 15 plane reads (mu o/m x3, img_sq o/m x3, i12 x3), channel-averaged mu products and sigmas, single SSIM quotient per pixel. map_out collected as full ImgVec even though maps are discarded.

stages.name: per-scale score folds (mean, mean |dev|, powf reweight)
stages.notes: Two sequential folds over the map (sum -> avg, sum|avg-i| -> score) plus a per-scale powf(0.5^n) once per level (folded into level scalar). log2 span for parallel fold.
